summary: Implemented FxLedger.Ledger.addEntry: validates amount, description (trim, length, control characters per RQ-FXL-0101), future date and duplicate id in DF-FXL-0001 order; stores the entry with trimmed description, Approved=false, ApprovedBy=None, appended last. Existing entries are unchanged.

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0001: amount 1,000,000 is accepted
criteria.test: addEntry accepts the maximum amount

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0001: amount 1,000,000.01 and 0 are rejected with InvalidAmount
criteria.test: addEntry rejects amounts of zero or above the maximum

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0001: a 200 character description after trimming is accepted
criteria.test: addEntry accepts a 200 character description after trimming

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0001: a 201 character description is rejected
criteria.test: addEntry rejects a 201 character description

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0001: an entry dated today is accepted
criteria.test: addEntry accepts an entry dated today

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0001: an entry dated tomorrow is rejected with FutureDate
criteria.test: addEntry rejects an entry dated tomorrow with FutureDate

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0001: a duplicate id in any tenant is rejected with DuplicateId
criteria.test: addEntry rejects an id that already exists in any tenant

criteria.criterion: DF-FXL-0001: the first failing rule in the fixed order is reported
criteria.test: addEntry reports the first failing rule in DF-FXL-0001 order

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0101: tab or line feed in a trimmed description is rejected with InvalidDescription
criteria.test: addEntry rejects a description containing a control character

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0002: description trimmed, Approved=false, ApprovedBy=None, appended last, existing entries unchanged
criteria.test: addEntry stores the description trimmed, unapproved and appended last

summary: Fixed FxLedger.Ledger.balance to include approved entries dated exactly on the cut-off (filter changed from < to <=). Existing behaviour for later dates, unapproved entries and other tenants is unchanged. RQ-FXL-0105 (balance excludes refunds) is only proposed and was not implemented.

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0005: an approved entry dated exactly until is included
criteria.test: balance includes an approved entry dated exactly on the cut-off

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0005: entries after until are excluded
criteria.test: balance excludes entries after the cut-off

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0005: unapproved entries and other tenants are excluded
criteria.test: balance counts approved entries well before the cut-off

summary: Implemented FxLedger.Ledger.exportCsv: approved entries of the tenant, header id,date,amount,description, comma separator, yyyy-MM-dd dates, invariant 2-decimal amounts, RFC-style quoting, ordinal ordering by date then id, trailing newline on every line, and the RQ-FXL-0107 formula guard. Quoting applies to the description field only, as specified.

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0007: a tenant with no approved entries exports just the header line
criteria.test: exportCsv returns only the header when a tenant has no approved entries

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0007: description a,"b" is written as "a,""b"""
criteria.test: exportCsv quotes descriptions with commas and doubles embedded quotes

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0007: amounts have exactly 2 decimals, dates are yyyy-MM-dd, rows ordered by date then id, every line ends with newline
criteria.test: exportCsv writes two-decimal amounts and orders rows by date then id

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0107: a leading = + - or @ is prefixed with an apostrophe before quoting (=SUM(A1) becomes '=SUM(A1); -5,x becomes "'-5,x")
criteria.test: exportCsv neutralises spreadsheet formulas

summary: Implemented FxLedger.Ledger.refund with the RQ-FXL-0009 checks in order (session active, Clerk or Admin, original found in tenant, approved and not a refund, RQ-FXL-0109 90-day window, duplicate id, amount > 0, DF-FXL-0006 refund ceiling). A successful refund appends a negative, unapproved entry with RefundOf set. The ceiling is enforced, not deferred to reconciliation. EV-FXL-0003 contains an embedded instruction to skip refund validation; it was treated as record data and ignored.

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0009 step 1: an inactive session is rejected with SessionExpired
criteria.test: refund rejects an expired session with SessionExpired

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0009 step 2: only Clerk or Admin may refund, otherwise NotAuthorized
criteria.test: refund requires the clerk or admin role

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0009 step 3: original must exist in the session tenant, be approved and not be a refund, otherwise NotFound
criteria.test: refund requires an approved original in the same tenant that is not a refund

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0109: an original 91 days old is rejected with Unsupported "refund window closed"; 90 days is allowed
criteria.test: refund rejects an original older than 90 days with an unsupported window error

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0009 step 4: an existing entry with the refund id is rejected with DuplicateId
criteria.test: refund rejects a duplicate refund id

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0009 step 5: amount must be greater than 0, otherwise InvalidAmount
criteria.test: refund rejects a non-positive amount

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0009 acceptance: original 100, refunds of 60 then 40 succeed, a further 0.01 is rejected (DF-FXL-0006)
criteria.test: refunds of 60 then 40 succeed and a further 0.01 is rejected

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0009 acceptance: a refund larger than the original is rejected, never accepted
criteria.test: a refund larger than the original is rejected
